
DESCRIPTION
Generate hk checks, migrate default Husky hooks, and install local Git launchers

USAGE
  one configure hooks [flags]

EXAMPLES
  one configure hooks --dry-run -o json
  one configure hooks
  one hk check --all

COMMON OPTIONS
  --dry-run                Preview configuration, migration, and local hook files without changing anything
  -o, --output <value>     Output format: json | yaml | text (default: terminal-friendly text, JSON when piped)
